gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 128 KiB EEPROM (cut 262144 -> 131072; the rest was all 0xFF)
